rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for brass instruments as a class.

example.english: There are many brass instruments in the orchestra.
example.traditional: 管弦樂團入面有好多銅管樂器。
example.jyutping: gun2 jin4 ngok6 tyun4 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 tung4 gun2 ngok6 hei3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the brass section of an orchestra or band rather than for an individual instrument.

example.english: The band's brass section is performing brilliantly today.
example.traditional: 樂隊嘅銅管組今日演出好精彩。
example.jyutping: ngok6 deoi6 ge3 tung4 gun2 zou2 gam1 jat6 jin2 ceot1 hou2 zing1 coi2

rows.note: Use this for senior people in an organization or institution, especially when referring to the higher-ups collectively.

example.english: This plan has to wait for the brass to sign off.
example.traditional: 今次個計劃要等高層拍板。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 go3 gai3 waak6 jiu3 dang2 gou1 cang4 paak3 baan2

rows.note: Use this colloquial noun for audacity or nerve when the speaker is criticizing the person's cheek or foolhardiness.

example.english: You’ve got some brass, saying that in front of the boss!
example.traditional: 你真係有狗膽，敢喺老闆面前咁講！
example.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 jau5 gau2 daam2 gam2 hai2 lou5 baan2 min6 cin4 gam2 gong2
